profile.headline: Software Engineer @ Meta
profile.summary: I am a results-driven Software Engineer with over 3 years of experience, known for crafting robust solutions. I build scalable and maintainable codebases, seamlessly navigating technical challenges and collaborating effectively with cross-functional teams. Adhering to the "Leave No Trace" principle, I ensure the codebase is always cleaner than I found it. My goal is for the code I write to be appreciated by both engineers and users alike.

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.locationName: New York, New York, United States

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.locationName: Los Angeles, California, United States · Remote
positions.description:
- Integrated the machine learning-powered delivery prediction engine into Shippabo’s flagship application, significantly optimizing logistical efficiency and forecasting accuracy.

- Developed Shippabo's flagship shipment visibility features: shipment cluster maps, shipment detail maps, and shipment health timelines for hundreds of active shipments.

- Engineered a suite of responsive, pixel perfect React components using TypeScript, Tailwind CSS, and Storybook, adhering to atomic design principles to create a cohesive design language.

- Improved webpage load times by analyzing and replacing bloated packages with smaller, more performant alternatives.

- Designed the MongoDB schema for multiple data models and API interfaces for various packages.

- Followed Clean Architecture best practices, wrote detailed documentation, and wrote integration/unit tests with Jest and Playwright.

- Regularly deployed production builds, migrated production data, reviewed pull requests, collaborated with product and design, and facilitated sprint planning.
positions.insights: Skills: GraphQL · Application Programming Interfaces (API) · React · Node.js · Google Cloud Platform (GCP) · Communication · Tailwind CSS · TypeScript · Playwright · Jest · MongoDB · Storybook · JavaScript · Schema Design · HTML · Cascading Style Sheets (CSS)

positions.title: Software Developer
positions.locationName: St Louis, Missouri, United States · Remote
positions.description:
- Designed and built a comprehensive Learning Management System (LMS) from scratch for healthcare professionals taking continuing education.

- Built out live video conference rooms with WebRTC that supported real-time chat via websockets.

- Developed pre-course surveys, post-course surveys, user feedback submission forms, and many more responsive, pixel perfect React components with TypeScript, and Material UI.

- Designed MongoDB schemas for multiple data models, implemented user authentication with AWS Cognito, optimized database queries for efficiency, and developed Express.js endpoints.

- Reviewed pull requests and provided mentorship in pair programming sessions to enhance team coding standards.

- Thrived in an Agile Scrum setting, executing bi-weekly sprints with Azure DevOps, and maintaining high productivity.
positions.insights: Skills: Application Programming Interfaces (API) · React · Node.js · Communication · TypeScript · Jest · Material-UI · MongoDB · Schema Design · Code Review · JavaScript · Amazon Web Services (AWS) · HTML · Cascading Style Sheets (CSS)

positions.title: Frontend Developer
positions.description:
- Developed and optimized a library of React components, enhancing UI/UX through redesign and refactoring.

- Utilized Redux and Redux-Saga for efficient asynchronous state management.

- Seamlessly integrated Google and Outlook Calendar APIs to synchronize workout schedules with a local storage queue.

positions.title: Frontend Developer Intern
positions.description:
- Refactored the codebase to improve scalability and maintainability.

- Wrote unit tests to increase code coverage and catch bugs early.

- Teamed with engineers using git workflows for collaborative coding.

projects.title: SAGACITY
projects.description:
• Full-stack web application with a Django back-end, and React front-end
• Features include: journaling, sharing and liking stories/experiences, health clinic finder,
healthy habit tracker, and a serene music player/customizable background

projects.title: TIKTOK
projects.description:
• Built an interactive homepage that allows users to scroll through multiple videos, play only one video at a time, pause/replay videos, and list/post comments
• Used React Native to design a responsive and modular app for both iOS and Android devices
